member.name: M:Owid.Client.Controllers.OwidController.ClampToNow(System.Nullable{System.UInt32})
member.summary: The requested date, or the moment of the request where the date is later than that. A schedule is published ahead of time, so a date in the future names a key that has not started and has signed nothing, and the key in force now is the only honest answer for it. A count past the range of is later than now as well, so it takes the same answer rather than an error.

member.name: M:Owid.Client.Controllers.OwidController.GetPublicKey(System.Nullable{System.UInt32})
member.summary: Returns the public key for the OWID creator. With a date, returns the key in force at that date; without one, the key in force now. A date later than the moment of the request is read as that moment.
member.param: Optional date as minutes since 2020-01-01 UTC (the OWID date encoding).
member.returns: The public key, or 404 when no key was active at the requested date.

member.name: M:Owid.Client.Controllers.OwidController.GetCreator(System.Nullable{System.UInt32})
member.summary: Returns the creator domain and signing public key. With a date, returns the key in force at that date; without one, the key in force now, and a date later than the moment of the request is read as that moment. This matches the public-key end point so the two agree.
member.param: Optional date as minutes since 2020-01-01 UTC (the OWID date encoding).
member.returns: The creator info, or 404 when no key was active at the requested date.
